summary_1line: The gods reaffirm that the sage Jaratkaru must marry Vasuki’s sister to beget Astika, who will later save the virtuous serpents from destruction.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vasuki, the giant serpent king, coils himself as the churning rope while gods and Asuras churn the cosmic ocean.
The serpent king Vasuki stands before Brahma with the gods gathered around, pleading for relief from his mother’s curse.
Serpents gather around their king as he commands them to watch for the wandering ascetic sage Jaratkaru who may ask for a wife.
